method: Inventory coverage against Orca 1.4.238: every row in PARITY-AUDIT sections 2.1–2.19 has an explicit covered/total functional checklist and an S=1, M=2, L=4 or XL=8 size weight; accepted platform/language exclusions have no weight. Functional area coverage is 100*sum(row weight*covered/total)/sum(row weights), with VISUAL-ONLY and MISSING rows contributing zero. Visual rows score 0 for no corresponding surface, 0.5 for a partial, standalone or GUI-unverified surface, and 1 for an implemented representative surface with recorded GUI evidence; backend-only rows score zero because the shared-weight schema has no visual-N/A field. These measure this declared inventory, not pixel fidelity or complete API/argument compatibility; current code/tests/reference were inspected, while execution evidence is explicitly attributed to UI-WIRING and prior runs. Areas partition the inventory into 26 groups; percentages are rounded to two decimals and overall values must be computed as weight-weighted means.

areas.name: Terminal, panes and tabs
areas.notes: Streaming/OSC52/T1 real; imports, shell integration and newer GUI checks remain (N09).

areas.name: Windows and floating surfaces
areas.notes: Shared AppModel; no independent windows or floating panel.

areas.notes: Host lifecycle and app paths real; navigation/groups/cleanup integration remain (N01).

areas.name: Explorer, search and file opening
areas.notes: Real host file ops/search; external editor/terminal actions remain (N03).

areas.name: Editor, markdown, viewers and diffs
areas.notes: Git diff text only; no editing/viewer surface.

areas.name: Mobile companion
